title: Emit EnforcementGaps from all enforcement points
description: WHY: gaps must come from the same code that enforces, or drift returns. WHAT: refactor the enforcement sites to produce EnforcementGap values and carry them in both failure and success paths. Sites, with citations: applyRequiredCloseoutGatePolicy and evaluateRequiredCloseoutGate (packages/engine/src/runtime.ts lines 1266-1381) replace CloseoutGateGap with EnforcementGap; closeWork policy check (packages/work-engine/src/work.ts lines 285-308); verifySubject policy checks (packages/evidence-engine/src/evidence.ts lines 75-109); reserveWork status and capacity checks (packages/agent-runtime/src/reservations.ts lines 44-95); deriveReadinessStatus blocked derivation reified as gaps listing the open dependency ids (work.ts lines 310-325); assertAgentSummaryClosePolicy (runtime.ts lines 1190-1212). BorealError gains an optional gaps field so a thrown violation carries its gaps, and successful command envelopes gain an optional gaps array for advisory state (for example open gates on work show). Keep every existing error code and message stable; gaps are additive. The CLI does not render gaps yet beyond including them in JSON output.
acceptanceCriteria: Every BOREAL_POLICY_VIOLATION thrown from the cited sites carries at least one EnforcementGap with a stable code
work show --json on a fixture item with an open gate includes the corresponding advisory gap
No existing error code or message string changes, verified by the existing test suite passing unmodified
